text:
Phase margin is 50.4° against a 55° target, and the other four specs pass with margin. The likely cause is the mirror and out1 node capacitance from the large input pair, so a parameter refine should be enough. Noise and power have room for this trade.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "Topology works; only PM short by ~5 deg. Lower gmid1 (strongest sensitivity) and shorten L3 to shrink mirror/out1 capacitance. Raise I7 to lift the output pole and kz to push the zero into the LHP. Trim gbw toward 12.5 MHz. Increase I1 to hold flicker noise under 50 nV."}
```

Values for the refine:

```json
{"params": {"gbw": 12.5e6, "I1": 70e-6, "gmid1": 17, "L1": 5.0, "gmid3": 9, "L3": 1.2, "I7": 290e-6, "gmidn": 13, "Ln": 1.0, "kz": 1.3},
 "bounds": {"gbw": [11.5e6, 16e6], "gmid1": [14, 20], "L3": [0.8, 2.5], "I7": [200e-6, 320e-6], "kz": [0.8, 2.0], "I1": [50e-6, 90e-6]}}
```
